availability.media_reason: Every selected episode declares video_saved=false and frames_captured=0. Other filmstrips belong to different protocols and are excluded.
availability.visualization: 2D orthographic schematic from recorded roll, pitch, height and joint angles. Link lengths and body geometry are illustrative, not calibrated forward kinematics.

contract.claim_boundary: Archived simulator execution, one feedback decision. No repeated replanning, live simulation, or hardware recovery.
contract.energy_units: Forecast energy, port and modal factors are model-coordinate readouts, not calibrated joules.
contract.forecast_storage: Only eight-step aggregate candidate forecasts were archived; no per-step predicted pose trajectories.
contract.head_caveat: Online choice uses pre-action measured factors. The frozen offline probe recomputes current-state factors from post-step row 76; its ranking is a separate evaluation.
contract.information: Current root/joint telemetry, contact/slip geometry, declared terrain and candidate commands; no push label, push magnitude or future state.
contract.score_semantics: Bounded pairwise preference; higher is better. Not a calibrated recovery probability or predicted survival in steps.
contract.survival: First recorded failure step, or 140 if no failure. Recording may continue after failure. Last recorded sample and simulator done are separate; done samples can contain reset state and must not be presented as recovery.
contract.timing: Diagnostics row t is post-action t. The step-76 forecast starts from post-step 75, predicts post-steps 76..83, and the command is latched for actions 76..99.

parameters.notes: candidate_state_combined pairwise_logistic head fit on development-only forced policy-command branches. Online inputs are C-PHAST candidate factors and candidate identity; no simulator outcome or push label is used.
